answer: Sponsor-garden vouching: each fake costs 3 established sponsors who each lock one anchor slot for 12 epochs, so 1,000 fakes burn 36,000 sponsor-epochs. Check: at every close the vouch garden is audited; if a sponsor's invitees post correlated answers (similarity over 0.9) the cluster is pruned and its sponsors lose standing. A farm cannot parallelize this, because slots come from scarce real identities, not compute: the ocean of fresh keys is free, anchors are not. Limit: colluding sponsors can seed a few fakes before pruning.
